name: Molecular Pharmacology and Therapeutics PhD
summary: Research PhD in molecular pharmacology and therapeutics.
detailsNote: Official available requirements. Current Fall 2027 application deadline established. Funding amounts have no stated academic year unless noted; confirm offer. Admission model omitted unless directly established.

english.toefl: 79 with W21/R19 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 total/W/R on or after
english.note: IELTS reading/writing 6.5; Fall 2027 DET total/reading/writing 120. Scores within two years of start. Twin Cities does not accept TOEFL MyBest; IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted. Education exemption: secondary school in US/listed country, or 16 semester/24 quarter non-ESL postsecondary credits completed within past two years while living in US/listed country. Program may require higher scores. MPaT requires IELTS overall 7.0, higher than central.

applicationFee.note: US citizen/PR $75, international $95; nonrefundable. Central office does not waive fees. GSDO conditional route: US citizen/PR seeking first graduate degree with qualifying listed participation; request before submission/payment. Medical School may offer limited domestic waivers; confirm program procedure.

documents: Unofficial transcripts and English translations, official after admission
requirements.note: Four-year BA/BS equivalent in life or physical sciences. Research not formally required; competitive applicants have moderate/extensive experience. Average matriculating GPA 3.5, not a stated cutoff. No WES certification required. Department asks applicants not to provide GRE. Optional extra research/extenuating-circumstances materials neither help nor hinder.

funding.note: Standard annual stipend $38,240.80 ($36.77/hour), undated; full tuition for all accepted doctoral students; health coverage 95%, dependent subsidy possible. Department pays academic fees first three semesters; fees reduce from year three. Benefits continue with good academic standing.
